 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mrs. Namrata Mishra, Sr. Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ashok Kumar Singh, APP  For the informant : Mr. Santosh Kumar Singh, Adv.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 3 08-05-2025 Heard Mrs. Namrata Mishra, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner, Mr. Santosh Kumar Singh representing the informant as also Mr. Ashok Kumar Singh, learned APP.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 241 of 2024 for the offence registered under sections 406, 420, 504 of the IPC.
3. Since the parties have appeared, with the agreement, the matter is sent to the Mediation Centre where they shall appear on 15.05.2025 and try to take the matter to its logical conclusion.

4. In the meantime, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner undertakes to bring on record all the documents to show that he is registered firm to deal with such business either with the Central or the State Government.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.88422 of 2024(3) dt.08-05-2025 5.
Copies to be served upon the parties including the learned APP and learned counsel for the informant on time before filing to the Court.

6. List this case on 10.07.2025.
